formulas.formula: Triangular inverse CDF: if U < (m-a)/(b-a): x = a + sqrt(U(b-a)(m-a)); else x = b - sqrt((1-U)(b-a)(b-m))
formulas.variables: a optimistic, m most likely, b pessimistic (working days or £); U uniform random number in [0,1)
formulas.result: switch point 0.286; x=21.63 days (U=0.5); x=19.35 days (U=0.2); sampled mean of A (8/10/16) = 11.333 vs theoretical 11.333

formulas.formula: Deterministic finish = A + max(B, C) + D + E; deterministic cost = sum of most-likely direct costs + £2k x duration
formulas.variables: durations in working days; cost in £k
formulas.result: 42 days; £429k (path A-C-D-E 37 days, C float 5 days)

formulas.formula: Monte Carlo (100,000 iterations, seed 1, triangular, independent)
formulas.inputs: Activity/cost/risk table in article; R1 25% +5/10/15 days on B; R2 15% +5/8/15 days on C and £18k

formulas.formula: Mean decomposition: sum of triangular means (a+m+b)/3 on A-B-D-E; no-risk simulation; full simulation
Gaussian copula, pairwise rho=0.5 on all five durations (separate run)
Iteration convergence: SD of P80 across 20 seeds
Sampling error of a proportion = sqrt(p(1-p)/n)

formulas.result: sum of P80s 53.97; P80 of sum 50.67
